title: The panel's declared lists
description: What a declared panel names from this package: the widgets a control is drawn with, the roles that repeat by index and the rule that shows a control by another control's value. A plugin's own declaration schema references these $defs; tools/modgui-gen.mjs and tools/panel-description.mjs read them.

widget.title: Widget
widget.description: The standard widgets of docs/panel-layout.md, by the names the console reads (its `auto` is a control left out of `widgets`): a knob or a fader for a travel, a switch for a toggle, a selector for an integer travel or labelled values, a meter or a display for a read-only control, a curve for a section's graph, an xy for a pair. Each has its gestures in schema/gestures.json; the MOD GUI draws the first four. The schema, tools/modgui-gen.mjs and the console read this one list; a new one is added here once, and in each renderer, for every plugin.

indexedRole.title: Indexed role
indexedRole.description: The roles that repeat by index, one parameter per band: the only roles that may name a list of symbols.

easy.title: Easy controls
easy.description: The controls the plugin opens on, in order, by symbol. Every control stays one click away. Left out, tools/easy.mjs picks them from the roles.

visibleWhen.title: Visibility
visibleWhen.description: Control symbol to the rule that shows it: the control is drawn, and takes a page slot, only while its rule holds. tools/panel-description.mjs carries each rule into the panel description's visible and mask.

param.description: The governing parameter's symbol: an integer or toggle parameter of the plugin.

values.description: The values that show the control.

param.description: The governing parameter's symbol: an integer or toggle parameter of the plugin.

atLeast.description: A count: the control is shown while the value is this or more (mask bits n to 63).

visibleWhenRule.title: Visibility rule
visibleWhenRule.description: Shown while `param` holds one of `values`, or, for a count, while it is `atLeast` n.

bars.title: Bar group
bars.description: A declared section's `bars`: true, the section's controls in order are one bar group (a row of thin faders, one per control, the label of each under it); the bar rule's checks still apply (at least 4 controls, each a visible writable travel with the same ends, step, unit and scale, labels in one series) and a failing one refuses the layout by code. false, no bar group is inferred in the section. Left out, tools/bars.mjs infers one where the rule holds. The field is a view of the panel: it stays out of the canonical form and the fingerprint.

origins.title: Band origins
origins.description: A declared panel's band_freq symbol to the planter that owns the band (the console's BAND_ORIGINS). Only an authored descriptor declares one; a surface draws a mark at each such band on the curve and infers none.

basis.title: Display basis
basis.description: A declared section graph's `basis`: `exact` when the plugin's own audio runs the closed form the curve draws (only an authored descriptor can say so), else `modelled`, which every surface prints beside the curve.

perPage.title: Controls per page
perPage.description: How many controls a page of the layout holds: 8 for the CLAP remote-controls surface and an X-Touch, 8 per bank on a C24, 4 for a Zynthian's encoders. `omx-panel layout --pages --per-page N` cuts each section into pages of at most N controls, in the section's order, keeping a declared group whole when it fits a page.
